oneLine: 提出仅基于注意力的 Transformer，抛弃循环与卷积，在翻译任务上更快更强。

sections.title: 摘要拆解
sections.summary: 摘要逐句拆开：问题、做法、两个翻译任务上的结果与推广。

anchors.quote: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms

children.title: 背景
children.summary: 主流序列转导模型基于复杂的循环或卷积网络，含编码器-解码器。

anchors.quote: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks

children.title: 已有方法
children.summary: 表现最好的模型再通过注意力机制连接编码器与解码器。

anchors.quote: The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism

children.title: 方法
children.summary: 提出 Transformer：完全依赖注意力，彻底去掉循环与卷积。

anchors.quote: dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely

children.title: 实验
children.summary: 两个机器翻译任务上质量更优、更可并行、训练更省时。

anchors.quote: Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable

children.title: 结果
children.summary: 英德 28.4 BLEU，比含集成的最佳结果再高 2 BLEU 以上。

anchors.quote: improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU

children.title: 结论
children.summary: 同一套结构直接用于英语成分句法分析也成立。

anchors.quote: the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing

sections.title: 任务背景
sections.summary: 序列建模与机器翻译的 SOTA 一直是 RNN / LSTM / GRU 的编码器-解码器。

anchors.quote: have been firmly established as state of the art approaches in sequence modeling and transduction problems

children.title: 串行瓶颈
children.summary: 隐状态逐步依赖前一步，样本内无法并行，长序列还受内存限制。

anchors.quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples

sections.title: 传统方法及问题
sections.summary: 注意力成了标配，但几乎总是挂在循环网络旁边用。

anchors.quote: Attention mechanisms have become an integral part of compelling sequence modeling and transduction models

children.title: 卷积替代
children.summary: ByteNet / ConvS2S 用卷积并行算，但关联任意两位置的运算量随距离增长。

anchors.quote: the number of operations required to relate signals from two arbitrary input or output positions grows in the distance between positions

sections.title: 核心 Gap
sections.summary: 因子分解与条件计算提了效率，串行计算的根本约束仍在。

anchors.quote: The fundamental constraint of sequential computation, however, remains

sections.title: 本文方法
sections.summary: 编码器与解码器各堆 6 层，全靠多头自注意力 + 逐位前馈，配残差与层归一化。

anchors.quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of N = 6 identical layers

children.title: 多头自注意力
children.summary: h = 8 个头并行，投影到 dk = dv = 64 的子空间，总计算量与单头相当。

anchors.quote: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces

children.title: 位置编码
children.summary: 既无循环也无卷积，故用不同频率的正弦余弦把位置信息加进输入。

anchors.quote: we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence

sections.title: 数据结果
sections.summary: WMT 2014 英德 28.4 / 英法 41.8 BLEU，8 张 P100 训 3.5 天即刷新单模型 SOTA。

anchors.caption: Table 2: The Transformer achieves better BLEU scores than previous state-of-the-art models

anchors.quote: the big transformer model (Transformer (big) in Table 2) outperforms the best previously reported models

children.title: 消融
children.summary: 单头比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多质量反而下降。

anchors.caption: Table 3: Variations on the Transformer architecture. Unlisted values are identical to thos

anchors.quote: single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads

sections.title: 结论
sections.summary: 首个完全依赖自注意力的序列转导模型，训练与推理都远快于循环结构。

anchors.quote: we presented the Transformer, the first sequence transduction model based entirely on attention
